fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
It all began on an ordinary Tuesday evening, in a small bookshop in Kadıköy. Two hands reaching for the same book at the same moment, a shy smile and the words “You take it, I'll wait”… One of us kept the book, the other the phone number.
Then came long walks, conversations that lasted until morning, cities we got lost in together. We became each other's best friend; in laughter and in hard times, we were always on the same side.
One summer evening, a single question asked outside the bookshop where we first met changed everything. The answer was short: “Yes.” Now we want to write the most beautiful page of this story together with you.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We're so lucky to have you; here's to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.name: Künye alt bandı
elements.text: Us in numbers  ·  Statistics special issue  ·  Seven years on the books

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Seven years, audited: 2,555 days, 1,840 cups of coffee, 14 cities and a single “yes.” Numbers don't lie.

elements.name: Kapak altyazısı
elements.text: Figure 1 · The study's two volunteer participants, on the final day of the seven-year data set.

elements.name: Kaynak
elements.text: Note: 2023 was a record year; the map got lost four times.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: A love in statistics: seven years, one chart

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
Every re­la­tion­ship has its sta­tis­tics; ours run a little high. In seven years we've racked up 2,555 days, 1,840 cups of coffee and 14 cities. The bride kept count and the groom took on the anal­y­sis; but in the end, both looked at the same chart: a line going up.
In this spe­cial issue we present the seven-year bal­ance sheet with old-school rulers and charts. Who runs late more often, who reads the map, whose turn it is for coffee… All the an­swers are inside. One figure we'll reveal right away: the number of “yes” an­swers given is one, and that de­ci­sion is final. The full charts, com­plete with coffee stains and margin notes, await you on the inside pages.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Numbers don't lie: one brings the coffee, the other the patience; who hits the dance floor first is still unclear.

elements.text: Guests who'll kick off their shoes

elements.text: So no one is left out when we count tables, please RSVP two weeks in advance.

elements.name: Altyazı
elements.text: Figure 6 · The most beautiful point in the data set.

elements.name: Kaynak
elements.text: Dashed line: forecast. Margin of error: one laugh.

elements.name: Metodoloji
elements.text: All fig­ures in this issue were com­piled from the bride and groom's shared memory. The coffee count may show a slight de­vi­a­tion; the bride kept the records and the groom ob­ject­ed. Maps found again were not count­ed. The hap­pi­ness index is the av­er­age of Sunday break­fasts, laughs and long walks. All the data point to a single con­clu­sion: we're better to­geth­er.
